subject.why: Base camp habitat is clearly depicted with all requested elements, including the antenna, solar panel, and flower.

category.why: Object rests solidly on a wide ground plane with a low perspective and simple background.

clean.why: No text, interface elements, or characters present.

framing.why: Central composition with well-balanced margins and a clear silhouette.

colour.why: Vibrant and saturated palette with clean separation between the dome and environment.

detail.why: Smooth surfaces without excessive texture, noise, or unprompted clutter.

style.why: Consistent with references, featuring chunky 3D forms, soft lighting, and a satin finish.
